provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: Joins nouns into one exhaustive list: パンと卵と牛乳 claims those items and no others, and the whole list fills a single slot in the sentence (パンと卵を買う). The other lanes of と are the companion in a mutual action (友達と話す), the conditional of an automatic result (春が来ると) or of something actually found (窓を開けると), and the written quotative との (中止との連絡). や in place of と names only samples and leaves the rest open.

examples.ruby: 朝[あさ]はパンと卵[たまご]と牛乳[ぎゅうにゅう]で済[す]ませる。
examples.english: For breakfast I make do with bread, eggs, and milk.

examples.ruby: 引[ひ]き出[だ]しには古[ふる]い切手[きって]と写真[しゃしん]と手紙[てがみ]が入[はい]っていた。
examples.english: The drawer held old stamps, photographs, and letters.

examples.ruby: 週末[しゅうまつ]は大阪[おおさか]と京都[きょうと]を回[まわ]る予定[よてい]だ。
examples.english: Over the weekend I plan to make the rounds of Osaka and Kyoto.
